name: web-neo-brutalist-lilac-portfolio-with-marquee-and-bordered-service-cells
title: Cream and lilac developer portfolio with a marquee, sticker portrait, bordered service cells and project tiles
whatItIs: A tall page with a newsletter marquee strip, a top nav with black rules, a hero 'Turning ideas into interactive realities' with a lime highlight and a lilac button beside a pink-hex portrait with tool stickers, three bordered service cells with circle icons, a lilac 'Featured Projects' band, alternating project rows with tags and buttons, and a testimonial with a lilac card.
whatItMeans: Playful and structured; black grid lines and sticker accents give personality.
techniques: Divide the page with black hairline grid lines.
Highlight one word with a lime block.
Use a marquee strip at the top.
Alternate image and text rows for projects.

vocabulary.definition: A grid cell divided by black lines.
A word on a lime block.
An image and text pair for one project.
